title: Lack of classic inflammation in subject with severe asthma | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: Endobronchial biopsy from severe asthmatic with minimal inflammation, but abundant mucus and airway edema.

title: Eosinophilic granulocyte in peripheral blood smear (human) | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: Stain: May-Grnwald-Giemsa (MGG). The eosinophil (11-15 μm) contains a bilobed nucleus and numerous large solitary brown-orange granules. The eosinophils are the first line of defense against parasites but also take part in allergic reactions (bronchial asthma). Arrow (↓) points to two platelets.
